A FEW USEFUL ANSWERS

Before you
make yourself at home.

The details that help turn a beautiful idea into a well-planned stay.

How many bedrooms does Alami have?+

Alami Villa has two bedrooms. Ask the owner to confirm bed sizes, layouts and the maximum guest capacity for your group.

Is the swimming pool private?+

Yes, the villa has a large private swimming pool. Pool dimensions, depth and child-safety arrangements should be confirmed before your stay.

Where is the villa located?+

Alami Villa is in Sri Lanka. The exact address, verified map pin and distances to nearby attractions are awaiting owner confirmation.

How do I check availability?+

Use the booking enquiry form to prepare your dates and guest details. The owner must confirm availability, rates and reservation terms directly.

Are breakfast or other meals included?+

Meal plans and any cooking or chef services have not yet been confirmed for Alami. Ask the owner what is available and whether it carries an additional charge.

What are check-in and check-out times?+

Arrival and departure times will be provided by the owner with your booking quote. Ask about early arrival or late departure for your dates.

Can I arrange transfers, tours or a special occasion?+

You can include these requests in your enquiry. Arrangements, availability and prices must be agreed with the owner; no extra service is included automatically.

What are the payment and cancellation terms?+

Rates, deposit requirements, accepted payment methods and cancellation conditions are confirmed directly by the owner before any reservation is made.

Can I book instantly on this website?+

This concept website prepares a booking enquiry. It does not show live availability, take payments or confirm a reservation.

Are the images of the actual Alami Villa?+

The current photographs and cinematic photo-motion film are illustrative design references. They will be replaced with approved Alami Villa photography and footage before launch.
